text: Faking a reputable expertise tag is nearly costless: a successful tag's open record can be copied and reposted under a new name for the price of the anti denial of service fees, and the capital used to mimic fees paid into the sham tag is mostly recovered by the sham owners through the salaries they control.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vlad Andrei, Blockchain Infrastructure for Measuring Domain Specific Reputation in Autonomous Decentralized and A (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3125822
